subject: history
concept: Understanding basic levels of government (local, regional/provincial or state, national) at an age-appropriate level
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student sorts decision cards (fixing a local park, national defense) into the level of government that would handle them
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a government level to an example decision it makes
exercise.abstract: Student explains which level of government would most likely handle a described issue

misconception_flags: assumes all government decisions are made at just one level

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
